adjudication.rationale: The diff changes the Disqus importer to call `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])` inside the per-thread loop (lib/tasks/disqus.thor). `TopicEmbed.import_remote` does a synchronous `open(url).read` and `Readability::Document.new(...)` with no rescue (app/models/topic_embed.rb), so network/parse errors will raise and can abort the entire import mid-run (a new failure mode vs the prior `PostCreator` path which didn’t fetch remote content). The previous `created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at])` is removed and not set anywhere in the new path, so imported topics will lose that metadata. The `--category` option and category handling are also removed in the diff. Additionally, `TopicEmbed.import` returns nil unless the URL matches `^https?://`, and `import_remote` passes through without validating scheme, so non-http(s) links can result in nil/no post (either via `open` raising or `import` returning nil), matching the finding’s “silently dropped” concern.
